construction.base: Per-equipment coordinate-wise median of 51,000 December-February training-cache observations; this constructed sensor combination is not an observed timestamp.
construction.other_features: Held at each equipment training median
construction.timestamp: 20250501000000 is a synthetic placeholder only; no May source or labels were read.
construction.model_state: Frozen March-selected model and thresholds; no retraining or recalibration.

limitations: The probes are constructed sensitivity checks, not real equipment-fault labels or estimates of real-world recall.

Single-sensor extreme values can have scores below the current Isolation Forest threshold despite violating the documented sensor rule. A finite threshold alone does not guarantee detection of unseen anomaly types.
Isolation Forest score magnitude outside the fitted ranges need not increase with physical severity; these probes do not establish a causal mechanism for misses.
Report the documented sensor-rule flag separately from the learned-model flag. Keep existing ML predictions and April proxy metrics unchanged.
Improved agreement with the supplied April markers does not prove that the model detects every unseen single-phase or physical fault.
